title_youtube: His Hair Caught Fire. He Kept Dancing.
description_youtube:
Take six of a 1984 commercial shoot went wrong in seconds.

• Jan 27, 1984 — Shrine Auditorium, Los Angeles
• Pyrotechnics fired early; sparks set Michael Jackson's hair alight
• Second- and third-degree burns to his scalp
• He gave his $1.5M Pepsi settlement to Brotman Medical Center, whose burn center was named for him
